high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "awakenedpage_." The post features a digital illustration of a figure with a humanoid body and a head resembling that of a jackal or dog, adorned with long, flowing black hair. The background has a textured, parchment-like appearance, giving it an ancient or mystical feel. The text overlay on the image reads: "The more fearful a person is, the more he uses his mind. The more fearless a person is, the more he uses his heart." This quote is attributed to Teal Swan. The post has received 3,214 likes.
